# Context Engineering {#sec-context-engineering}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- treat the context window as a budget with a measurable return;
- measure degradation as context grows instead of assuming a big window is free;
- apply compaction, isolation, and just-in-time retrieval deliberately;
- cut an agent's token usage substantially without losing task accuracy.

## Exercises

1. Instrument an agent and produce a token budget by category. Which category surprised you?
2. Run the same task at 8k, 32k, and 128k of context. Plot accuracy and cost. Was the bigger window worth it?
